settings.recordingDefaultsNote: Used for items not overridden by a rule or reservation
settings.ruleDefaultsNote: Values prefilled when creating a new rule. Existing rules do not change.
settings.poolHelp: When automatic, the pool that fits the estimated size is chosen in order of priority.
settings.fileNameTemplateHelp: Written in Go's text/template. The available syntax is listed in the table under "Show available syntax" below.
settings.priorityHelp: -10 to 10. When there are not enough tuners, higher-priority reservations get tuners first.
settings.joinSegments: Join split recording files into one
settings.joinSegmentsHelp: When a recording's files are split by an update or restart, they are joined into one file after the recording ends. If the overlaps do not match, the files are left split.
settings.archiveRetentionHelp: Number of days to keep programs that have finished airing in the guide and search. 0 keeps them indefinitely.
settings.notificationRetentionHelp: Number of days to keep in-app notifications. Notifications older than this are deleted daily, whether read or unread. 0 keeps them indefinitely.
settings.mcpHelp: Lets MCP clients such as Claude and ChatGPT work with programs, reservations, rules, and recordings. When disabled, neither new integrations nor already connected apps can be used.

recording.title: Recording defaults
recording.summary: Change recording settings not overridden by a rule or reservation, and the values prefilled when creating a rule

services.title: Services
services.summary: Change channel type display names, and which services appear in the guide and live and in what order

timeshift.title: Time shift
timeshift.summary: Continuously record the selected services and keep them for the retention time
timeshift.description: Continuously records the selected services and keeps them for the retention time. When a reservation recording or live needs a tuner, time shift stops and gives it up.
timeshift.unavailable: No time shift directory is configured for this tenban. To use it, set an absolute path in storage.timeshift_dir (environment variable KOTATSU_STORAGE_TIMESHIFT_DIR) and restart. The recording mikan needs the same setting.
timeshift.empty: No services are recorded for time shift
timeshift.confirmRemove: Remove {{name}} from time shift. The recorded buffer will be deleted.

storage.title: Storage
storage.summary: Change storage pool priority and space thresholds, and clean up recordings with missing files and files not in the DB

captions.title: Caption DRCS glyphs
captions.summary: Change the table that replaces caption DRCS glyphs (characters made by broadcasters) with text
captions.drcsHelp: DRCS glyphs that appear in captions are looked up by the MD5 of their image and replaced with text. The replacement text is used in the caption history, copying, and captions overlaid on video. Administrators can also register unregistered DRCS glyphs on the spot from the caption history.

retention.title: Retention
retention.summary: Change how many days to keep programs that have finished airing and in-app notifications

integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.summary: Set up integration with MCP clients and webhooks that send notifications to services such as Discord or Slack

streamURL.label: URL for external player
streamURL.description: Open it in VLC, mpv, or similar. You can open it any number of times until {{until}}.
streamURL.descriptionLive: Open it in VLC, mpv, or similar. You can open it any number of times until {{until}}. While open, it uses one tuner separately from watching in the browser.

remote.title: Remote
remote.empty: No players are playing on other devices
remote.emptyHint: Open live or recording playback on another device signed in to the same account to control it from here

captures.title: Capture history
captures.description: Keeps up to 100 captures taken on this device, newest first. Not synced with other devices.
captures.search: Search by program or service name
captures.emptyHint: Take a capture with the camera button on the player or the s key, and it will appear here.
captures.loadError: Couldn't read the capture history. Check that your browser settings allow this site to store data.

oauth.title: App authorization
oauth.description: {{name}} is requesting permission to use Kotatsu with your account. Choose the scopes to allow. The name is self-declared by the app, so deny if you don't recognize it
oauth.scopeReadHelp: Can read programs, reservations, rules, and recordings
oauth.scopeWriteHelp: Can create, change, and delete reservations and rules. Can also read
oauth.scopeNotAllowed: Your permissions do not allow this
oauth.disabled: The administrator has not enabled authorization for MCP clients
oauth.invalidRequest: The app's request is invalid, so it can't be authorized. Check the app's settings
oauth.errorRedirect: Returning to the app tells it that authorization failed. Returns to: {{host}}. If you don't recognize the site, close this screen without returning
